# clavis identities revoke

<p class="cli-lead">Revoke an identity and its tokens</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis identities revoke NAME
```

</div>

Delete an identity and revoke all its tokens immediately.

## Examples

```sh
clavis identities revoke deploy-bot
```
